Anthropic Economic Index September 2025 coding share

sources_considered.why: Representative usage study of ChatGPT, the largest LLM consumer product, through July 2025.
Provider usage data for Claude.ai and business API traffic, August 2025.
Survey-based report calling code generation the 'first killer app'. Not read directly, and it is not needed beyond the Anthropic data.

evidence_items.locator: Chapter on enterprise API use, 'Specialized use among Anthropic API customers'

receipt.public_excerpt: Overall, software development dominates the landscape. Among the top 15 use clusters—representing about half of all API traffic—the majority relate to coding and development tasks.

evidence_items.explanation: In business API use, the clearest commercial deployment, coding dominates. The same report puts coding at 36% of Claude.ai use. This supports coding being the leading evident use.

receipt.public_excerpt: Writing dominates work-related tasks, highlighting chatbots’ unique ability to generate digital outputs compared to traditional search engines. Computer programming and self-expression both represent relatively small shares of use.

evidence_items.explanation: ChatGPT reached about 10% of the world's adults. Its use is dominated by non-coding tasks, and writing leads work use. That cuts against coding being 'basically the only' obvious use.

unresolved_gaps: Usage share does not measure 'obviousness' or commercial value. The speaker may have meant use cases with a clear return, which no source here measures directly.
The NBER paper's authors include OpenAI employees, and the Anthropic data covers one provider only.
